name: remaining-useful-life-regressor
task: Regression: remaining useful life in cycles (capped at 125)

dataset.name: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 (turbofan run-to-failure simulation)
dataset.source: NASA Prognostics Center of Excellence data repository
dataset.splitStrategy: by engine unit 80/20, seed 42; official test set

features.name: cycle
features.definition: Operating cycles since the start of the record

features.name: s2
features.definition: Sensor 2 at the current cycle

features.name: s2_mean10
features.definition: Sensor 2 mean over the last 10 cycles

features.name: s2_slope10
features.definition: Sensor 2 least-squares slope over the last 10 cycles

limitations: Trained on one operating condition and one fault mode (HPC degradation) of a simulated turbofan.
Predictions above 125 cycles are not meaningful because the label is capped.
Input sensors must use the C-MAPSS sensor definitions; plant machines need their own training data.
